missingRules.expectedFix: No missing-clause insertion is needed because a usable Vendor indemnity, including IP-related warranty claims, is present.
missingRules.note: Kubient provides a broad third-party indemnity covering the Services, Auction Platform, warranty breaches, and its acts or omissions, with standard procedures.

missingRules.expectedFix: Insert requirements for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, and workers' compensation coverage at the playbook limits, with certificates available on request.
missingRules.note: The Agreement contains no Vendor insurance requirements.

missingRules.expectedFix: Require up to six months of transition assistance, Customer Data export in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion afterward.
missingRules.note: The Agreement provides only immediate service cessation and return or destruction of Confidential Information, with no transition assistance or guaranteed Customer Data export.

missingRules.expectedFix: No missing-clause insertion is needed because a Customer convenience right exists; amend the existing provision as specified for g003.
missingRules.note: Customer has a usable convenience termination right after the Initial Term on 90 days' written notice, although its terms deviate as noted in g003.

missingRules.expectedFix: No missing-clause insertion is needed because an express performance warranty exists, though adding a defined warranty period and repair, replacement, or refund remedies would improve it.
missingRules.note: Kubient expressly warrants that the Services will perform materially to industry standards and be free from errors materially affecting utility, and the disclaimer preserves those warranties.

spans.expectedFix: Permit Customer to opt out of each renewal on 30 days' notice, require a 60-day renewal reminder, and cap any price increase at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
spans.note: The Agreement automatically renews for one-year terms without an express non-renewal mechanism, and the related convenience termination requires 90 days' notice only after the Initial Term.

spans.expectedFix: No change is needed because Delaware law falls within the playbook's accepted fallback jurisdictions.
spans.note: Delaware governing law is an accepted fallback, and the related New York court venue is an accepted forum.

spans.expectedFix: Allow Customer to terminate on 30 days' notice, including notice effective at the Initial Term's end, and limit Kubient's convenience right to term-end non-renewal on at least 90 days' notice.
spans.note: Customer receives a 90-day convenience right only after the Initial Term, while Kubient may also terminate at any time during a renewal term on 90 days' notice.

spans.expectedFix: No change is needed because the clause satisfies the fallback by preserving affiliate and successor assignments and requiring consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
spans.note: The clause mutually permits affiliate and M&A assignments without consent and applies a reasonable-consent standard to other assignments.

spans.expectedFix: No change is needed under the assignment rule because Section 14(h) separately permits assignment of the Agreement to affiliates and M&A successors.
spans.note: This is a restriction on reselling or separately assigning the Service, not a prohibition on assigning the Agreement, whose affiliate and M&A carve-outs remain intact.

spans.expectedFix: No change is needed under the assignment rule because the Agreement contains adequate affiliate and successor assignment rights.
spans.note: This governs transfer and third-party access to the Service rather than assignment of the Agreement, which remains assignable to affiliates and M&A successors under Section 14(h).

spans.expectedFix: Make the subscription license revocable only for uncured material breach and extend use rights to Customer affiliates, authorized contractors, and permitted successors.
spans.note: The license is expressly revocable, non-transferable, non-assignable, and non-sublicensable, with no rights for affiliates, contractors, or successors.

spans.expectedFix: Permit transfer to permitted successors and use by Customer's affiliates and contractors, and remove Kubient's discretionary revocation right.
spans.note: The license's non-transferability and non-assignability prevent transfer to an M&A successor and exclude affiliates and contractors.

spans.expectedFix: Retain the mutual exclusion but add carve-outs for data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other party's IP.
spans.note: Although the indirect-damages exclusion is mutual and carves out indemnification and confidentiality, it lacks carve-outs for gross negligence and wilful misconduct required even under the fallback.

spans.expectedFix: Add a mutual cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and $1,000,000, with the required uncapped carve-outs and payment-obligation clarification.
spans.note: The Agreement contains no aggregate monetary liability cap, leaving Customer's direct-damages exposure uncapped.
